goal: Document a local package command with checksums so debug builds are repeatable (story 9.1, SEC-005).
outcome: Script records arch as arm64 unless DG-01 says otherwise; SBOM stub or cargo/pnpm list captured; no get-task-allow in release config.

requirements.statement: Never accept ADR-002, ADR-009, or ADR-018 silently; leave them Proposed.
Do not copy Cooper source or Copper trade dress.
Event-tap callbacks must not touch AX, DB, windows, clipboard, or logging.
No network, telemetry, accounts, remote fonts, CDN, hosted AI, or analytics.
Every user-facing string belongs in the locale catalog.
Preserve requirement IDs in implementation notes, tests, and evidence.
Work only on branch bmad/bronze-autonomous; never push.
Do not invent a Swift verify command; pnpm verify is the repo bar.
Given verify passes, when the packaging script is added, then arch is recorded as arm64 unless DG-01 says otherwise and release config has no get-task-allow.
